name: Interstate Route Marker
spec: red-white-and-blue shield with white legend INTERSTATE on the red band and large white numerals 80 on blue
meaning: Marks an Interstate highway route number.

snippets.back: A windshield is required, and original or replacement windows must use safety glass and provide clear driver vision.
Drowsiness is one of the biggest dangers of interstate driving, and stay-awake drugs are likely to make your driving more dangerous, not less.
On highways and interstates, the guide recommends looking at least a quarter of a mile ahead.
Parking on any freeway or interstate highway is illegal except in an emergency.
Windshield wipers and a defroster are required to clear rain, snow and similar obstructions.
Three-point turns are banned on interstate freeways, on curves, and near hilltops where drivers approaching within five hundred feet from either direction cannot see you.
Arkansas requires headlights whenever windshield-wiper use is necessary.
Freeways and interstate highways are built to carry higher-speed traffic safely.
